response.question: Does the order of three kinds of token evidence carry relation information that the native head discards after computing its gates and values? The specific prediction is that, among examples with similar native logits, errors depend on the order in which tokens with different combinations of overlap mass and signed value occur.
response.central_statement: For one relation and one sequence, write q_i = p_ri + 10⁻⁶, m_i = q_i/mean(q), s = z_r − b_r, and v_i = (m_i, m_i(u_ri − s)). The mean of the v_i is (1,0). Set c_i = v_i − (1,0) and A_r = n⁻² Σ_{i<j} det(c_i,c_j), in original token order. A prospective isolated plugin adds λA_r to z_r, with one signed λ shared across relations. A_r has two exact interpretations. It is a signed vote over ordered triples of native token contributions. It is also the component of the corresponding uncentered pair score orthogonal to every additive token-by-position score under a uniform permutation of the fixed records. The falsifiable task hypothesis is that this particular component predicts native errors after controlling for both native confidence and single-token position effects.
response.derivation: Assume n ≥ 1 unmasked tokens, finite scalar u_ri, and the native normalization in the question. All permutation statements hold the post-encoder (q_i,u_ri) records fixed. Permuting text and rerunning the encoder is a different operation. First, n⁻¹Σm_i u_ri = s, giving Σc_i = 0. Expanding the determinants gives A_r = n⁻³ Σ_{i<j<k} det(v_j−v_i,v_k−v_i). To see the equality, expand each triangle in centered pair determinants. The coefficient of det(c_i,c_j) is n−2(j−i), and Σ_{i<j}(j−i)det(c_i,c_j) = 0 by Σc_i = 0. Second, let B_r = n⁻²Σ_{i<j}det(v_i,v_j). Then B_r−A_r = n⁻²Σ_i(2i−n−1)det((1,0),c_i), indexing from 1. This is an explicit single-token position trend. Under a uniform permutation, the conditional mean of A_r given any one named token at any one position is zero. Pairs excluding that token cancel by exchange symmetry, and pairs including it sum to zero because its determinant with the sum of all other c_i is zero. Hence A_r is orthogonal to every sum of arbitrary single-record position functions under that null. For independent orientation of the proposed signal on real TRAIN, no permutation assumption is required. A_r can be computed exactly in one pass after native normalization by accumulating det(prefix sum of c,c_i).
known_tools: Signed areas, alternating determinants, and second-order sequence signatures are established order statistics.
Projection under a permutation null and the use of a held-out loss derivative to test a frozen feature are established tools.
The derivation identifies the exact statistic and its position control for this head. The algebra alone earns no novelty or task claim.
response.substantive_unproved_part: The proposed result would be a selective failure mode of native pooling. The original order of the overlap-mass and centered-value records would have to predict the direction of native relation errors across independent examples, and that prediction would have to weaken when the gate–value pairing is broken or the overlap is replaced by a credible classical gate. The position projection makes this more discriminating than testing whether an ordered readout helps. Its orthogonality is exact only under the permutation null, so position controls on natural examples are essential.
response.counterexample: If within each example and relation the tokens take only two distinct (m_i,m_i(u_ri−s)) values, every triple is collinear and A_r is identically zero. B_r can still be large and label-predictive through the explicit position trend. A second failure is possible with abundant noncollinear triples: if native errors depend only on which individual cues occur near an entity, real-order A_r can correlate with errors through text regularities and lose all incremental signal against position controls.
nearest_neighbor_questions: Do original sources on sequence signatures, ordered pooling, or relation extraction already use the signed second-order term of an attention gate and its own value numerator, with the additive position term removed?
Can an ordinary scalar query–key gate with the same value path recover the same residual-error signal? A positive answer would move the finding toward ordered attention pooling generally.
Does a position-aware single-token readout explain the natural-order result once entity-relative positions and the contextual encoder’s existing order information are available?

minimum_diagnostic.inputs: Use labeled real TRAIN examples, their original mask and order, and frozen native q, u and logits. Use a deterministic document- or source-group split where identifiers permit. Compute A, B−A, and the native softmax residual for every class that participates in the native CE. Audit the factor n, mask, bias subtraction and token order by checking the prefix implementation against the triple formula on short sequences. No parameter update is needed.
minimum_diagnostic.comparison: For feature F, compute the per-example native CE derivative D(F) = Σ_r(softmax(z)_r−1[y=r])F_r. Use one TRAIN partition to choose only the sign of λ and lock it for the other. On the second partition compare oriented A against the exact position term B−A, predeclared entity-relative single-token position controls, and A recomputed after shuffling values among tokens within each example and relation while keeping masses and positions fixed and recomputing s for that control. Keep the original native logits for every derivative. For incremental signal, residualize A against the native logits and position controls using coefficients estimated only on the first partition. Compare controls at matched root-mean-square logit perturbation after removing each example’s class-common shift.
minimum_diagnostic.success_gate: Advance to plugin training only if the locked direction reduces CE to first order on the second partition, the group-bootstrap interval for the mean oriented derivative of residualized A lies below zero, and the paired interval favors intact over shuffled pairing at matched perturbation size. Report relation-wise contributions so a background-class effect is visible. These are exploratory TRAIN gates because the native checkpoint may already have seen both partitions.
minimum_diagnostic.kill_gate: Close this lead if A is degenerate, the locked direction fails, position controls absorb the signal, or breaking the pairing performs equally well under the prespecified comparison. A favorable raw B score cannot rescue it. Even a pass leaves the matched classical gate and independent-task comparison outstanding.
minimum_diagnostic.resources: One frozen TRAIN pass if the records are uncached, followed by O(40n) arithmetic per example per permutation replicate. No circuit sampling, encoder reruns on permuted text, runner change, or plugin training is required for the first decision.

response.why_materially_different: This tests information lost when the native head turns an ordered list of token contributions into a normalized sum. The triples are triples of token records within one relation, with no circuit phase product or additional measurement. The proposed readout has a specific failure signature that can be checked before training. If it passes, a new isolated plugin would still need code-consistent benchmark evidence, original-source distinction, a matched classical comparison and independent task support. It inherits no fresh5 acceptance.
